svg.title: Pantropical aboveground carbon and its transfer to a worldwide annual account
svg.desc: Mapped pantropical aboveground carbon, 723.97 PgC at the source nominal 2007–2008 map epoch, excluding Australian tropics. Annual deforestation and degradation accounting includes all stem sizes, organ losses, abundance and release histories. Additional regions complete worldwide coverage. Hatching marks unresolved annual transfer, not rejection of the published stock. A positive omitted net source increases reconstructed atmospheric accumulation unless other terms offset it. A leading forest-loss attribution is a conditional hypothesis.
svg.text: Oil and gas extraction and refining
Pantropical stock ≠ worldwide total • global completion and annual transfer remain distinct
